$comment: Centralized AI provider configuration. API keys are ${ENV_VAR} placeholders resolved from the backend environment at startup. NEVER put a literal key in this file - it is committed to source control. Capability flags and token limits were VERIFIED against the live endpoint; each model note states what was measured and what is merely documented.

models.name: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B A12B
models.notes: Verified live: vision, json_schema and json_object all work. Reasoning model - returns reasoning_content and reasoning_tokens separately. LIMITS: maxInputTokens set to the ~1M context documented for this model by NVIDIA and multiple model catalogues. maxOutputTokens 131072 is the largest value verified to work in a REAL end-to-end call (test-plan generation). NVIDIA does NOT validate max_tokens - 200000 and 262144 were also accepted by the endpoint without error - so a larger value is untested and risks silent truncation rather than a clear failure. The brief example of 4096 was far too small: the reasoning trace consumed the whole budget and returned content:null with finish_reason=length.

models.name: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B A3B
models.notes: Text-only. Same limit basis as the VL model in this family: ~1M documented context, 131072 the largest verified output budget. Vision is flagged false until verified; the capability guard blocks image input rather than letting a request fail at the provider.

models.name: Llama 3.1 Nemotron 70B Instruct
models.notes: DISABLED - verified unavailable: listed by GET /v1/models but calling it returns HTTP 404 "Not found for account". Limits are the documented Llama 3.1 values and are UNVERIFIED because the model cannot be invoked on this account.

models.name: GPT-4o mini
models.notes: Disabled by default and present only to demonstrate that adding a provider is a configuration change. Limits are the published OpenAI values and are UNVERIFIED here. Its ${OPENAI_API_KEY} placeholder is not required to resolve while the provider is disabled.

defaults.$comment: reasoningOutputFloor: minimum output budget for models flagged isReasoningModel, so the reasoning trace cannot starve the answer. It is skipped automatically when thinking is false. thinking: reasoning mode per task - measured on nemotron-3.5-super-vl, disabling it cut output tokens ~6x (59-68 vs 264-412) while still returning schema-valid JSON 3/3. Left true everywhere by default; use the Model Lab to decide per task.
